title: Game-window observe v0.1 request params
description: Read-only VRChat game-window observation (environment.observeGameWindow): ordinary Win32 window APIs only — no client injection, no game-memory reads, no settings edits. Params are an empty closed set. The observation reports absent (no vrchat.exe process), waiting (process without a usable visible top-level window), or ready (exactly one selected window fact); state and window are consistent by construction (ready <=> non-null window). rectPhysical is physical pixels: the provider opts into per-monitor DPI awareness v2 before the first enumeration.

sessionId.description: Decimal pid + ':' + decimal hwnd; changes when the game relaunches or its window is recreated.

foreground.description: The current foreground window belongs to ANY vrchat.exe pid (game context active, not necessarily the selected window itself).
